name: black-mixed-heritage
description: Black and Black-Mixed history, heritage and cultures, Africa and the African diaspora: an evidence-based hub for Black History Month 2026 and all year, for the UK public sector and the communities it serves. Every figure is sourced. Source, build, tests and open data.
author: BHM 2026 Hub

scripts.build: cd src && cp src.v14.html src.html && python3 patch_v15.py && node build.mjs https://cyberdudeuk.github.io/black-mixed-heritage/ ../dist/bhm-2026-hub.html && rm -f src.html
scripts.build:pages: cd src && cp src.v14.html src.html && python3 patch_v15.py && node build_pages.mjs https://cyberdudeuk.github.io/black-mixed-heritage/ ../site && rm -f src.html
scripts.build:data: cd dist && HUB_FILE=bhm-2026-hub.html node ../src/export.mjs && cp data/* ../data/ && rm -rf data
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:pages && npm run build:data
